integrity: The all-parameter assertions have a complete elementary proof and reproducible finite checks, but neither external verification nor publication-priority determination has been performed. Prior tensor-product theorems are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern coordinatewise-inequality incidence on finite q-ary words, not general Hamming contexts. The product structure and the distinctions between direct and iterated implication bases are established in prior literature. Only maximum premise cardinality is optimized; no optimal rule count or time bound is proved. The specialized sharp width gap and exceptional symmetry may admit earlier equivalent formulations.
title: Antipodal Hamming concepts: box polarity, symmetry collapse, and sharp Horn arity
